QuestInfo.name: A Student of the Resistance
QuestInfo.0: Now you're a member of the Resistance! To find out what a member of the Resistance does, ask #b#p2151001##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2151001# says he can't send you on a mission until you reach at least #bLv. 14#k first. You can hunt to earn EXP to level up, but there is also an educational program available to Resistance members. Speak with #b#p2151010#, the Instructor#k.
QuestInfo.2: You met with #p2151010# and asked about the educational program for the Resistance.

0.0: So, you're ready for your first mission as a member of the Resistance. You get to go out and do...nothing! Yeah, that's right, kid. You aren't high enough level to be useful to us yet. It'd just put you in danger, and then we'd have to send someone to rescue you. You want to help out? Then get to #bLv. 14#k.

yes.0: Gain experience to level up. You can gain EXP by hunting monsters, but participating in the #bResistance Educational Program#k might be faster.
yes.1: #b#p2151010##k is in charge of the Resistance Educational Program. You can find  #p2151010# at #b#m310010010##k.
yes.2: Then see you at our next training session. I look forward to your achievements as a member of the Resistance.

no.0: I can't give you a mission until you reach level 14 anyway. Wouldn't want you getting hurt out there and crying all the way home. Train first, kid. Then fight.

1.0: We meet again. Congratulations on becoming a member of the Resistance! I've had my eye on you. I believe #p2151001# sensed potential in you when they sent you here.

npc.0: You haven't gone to see #b#p2151010##k yet? He's right over there, in front of the Training Room entrance to the right. What are you waiting for?
